site.name: PAIS Reviews
site.pilotBanner: Disclaimer: this is an early pilot project. Please do not share publicly yet.
home.intro: Each paper is reviewed against a published guide, [graded out of 10](/methods#grade-scheme), and summarised by its main strengths and weaknesses.
review.contextNote: Circumstances around the work, not part of the assessment of its methods.
review.guideNotesIntro: Points this paper raised that the [guide](/methods) does not yet cover. They are not applied to this review; the editor decides what goes into the next version. (These points mostly aren't very useful yet)
review.provenance: Read and published by the editor.
